## Audit findings, 2026-10-27

The cross-port security and correctness audit's findings for this port (AUDIT-LEDGER.md, heading lua). Reproducers are in /Volumes/nova/ai/rowan/working/serialize-love/audit2/serialize.lua/audit/. Each fix runs its reproducer first and confirms it fails.

### M: the precomputed compressed_float check lacks a uint32 bound on maxIntegerValue (U16)

serializeCompressedFloatPrecomputed accepts a maxIntegerValue outside uint32, giving wrong values or a raw raise. Same class as lobster's L finding. Reproducer: audit/precomputed_domain.lua. Done when: the reproducer passes: a maxIntegerValue outside uint32 raises (write, measure) and refuses as value_out_of_range (read) before any bit moves, with a unit test.

From: AUDIT-LEDGER.md, lua, M

### M: serializeBits writes an over-wide value masked, with no raise, despite the checked-writer doc (U8/U9)

A write whose value does not fit its bit count is silently masked rather than raised as misuse, though DESIGN.md (g) says the writer is strict. Reproducer: audit/bits_overwide.lua. Resolve the U8/U9 tension against IMPLEMENTING.md first. Done when: the reproducer passes: an over-wide value raises on write and measure, naming the rule, with a unit test.

From: AUDIT-LEDGER.md, lua, M

### L: no guard for LUA_32BITS; uint32 and uint8x8 reads go wrong or raise from the wire

On an interpreter built with 32-bit integers the reader decodes wrong values or raises on hostile bytes. Reproducer: audit/int32_build.lua (with audit/lua32/). Done when: loading the library on a LUA_32BITS interpreter raises by name (math.maxinteger below 2^63 - 1), with a unit test that fakes the check.

From: AUDIT-LEDGER.md, lua, L
